I've updated the **Detail DSLAM** screen with interactive prototype links to complete your navigation flow:

- **Назад (Back)**: The back button in the header now returns you to the **Inbox**.
- **История (History)**: Tapping this tab navigates to the **History** detail view.
- **Сервисы (Services)**: Tapping this tab takes you back to the **Services** detail view.

The Beltelecom brand identity, purple color palette, and technical data display have been strictly preserved. You can now test these transitions in the prototype preview.
